name: What plea options do I have in a San Diego misdemeanor case?

mainEntity.name: What plea options do I have in a San Diego misdemeanor case?

acceptedAnswer.text: You may plead guilty, not guilty, or no contest. Pleading not guilty leads to further proceedings and potentially a trial, while guilty or no contest may lead to sentencing or plea agreements.sandiegocounty+1​
